name: Picture on a screen
description: A picture or video laid onto a screen, a sign or a wall in perspective: four tracked corners carry it along.
description_de: Ein Bild oder Video liegt perspektivisch auf einem Bildschirm, einem Schild oder einer Wand: vier getrackte Ecken tragen es mit.
description_en: A picture or video laid onto a screen, a sign or a wall in perspective: four tracked corners carry it along.
note: Put the four corners on the screen first: {op:'track_node', clip, node:2, corners:[[x, y], [x, y], [x, y], [x, y]]} (0..1, clockwise from the top left; look with `frames` before) - it tracks them and the picture follows.

picture.description: the picture or video to lay onto the surface

left.description: left edge of the surface at the start, 0..1 (corners 1 and 4; drag them exactly in the viewer or give corners to track_node)
